---
title: "How far can tandem aspect ratio be pushed within the root bending budget?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
ENTRY_CEILING = 90.0   # s for this render, granted by the user
SOLVE_BUDGET = 15.0     # s for any one solve
PROBE_POOL = 200.0        # s granted for the probe
PROBE_SPENT = 199.8      # s the probe actually used

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Execute aspect ratio sweep for tandem wings up to baseline root bending budget
spans_eval = np.array([18.0, 23.0, 28.0, 32.86])
res = tandem_aspect_ratio_trade(airplane, spans=spans_eval)

b_base = float(res["spans"][0])
ar_base = float(res["ar_ref"][0])
ar_wing_base = float(res["ar_wing"][0])
ld_base_tandem = float(res["ld_max_arr"][0])
m_root_18 = float(res["m_root_arr"][0])
relief_18 = float(res["relief_arr"][0])

m_root_base = float(res["m_root_base"])
ld_base_mono = float(res["ld_base_max"])

b_limit = float(res["b_limit"])
ar_limit = float(res["ar_limit"])
ar_wing_limit = float(res["ar_wing_limit"])
ld_limit = float(res["ld_limit"])
delta_ld_limit = float(res["delta_ld_limit"])
delta_ld_base = float(ld_limit - ld_base_tandem)

k_limit = float(np.interp(b_limit, res["spans"], res["k_arr"]))
ir_limit = float(np.interp(b_limit, res["spans"], res["ir_arr"]))
```

::: {.hero}
[`{python} f"{ar_limit:.1f}"`]{.hero-value}
[maximum tandem aspect ratio reachable within the baseline root bending budget]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** Banking [`{python} f"{relief_18:.1f}%"`]{.key} root bending relief allows aspect ratio to be pushed to [`{python} f"AR {ar_limit:.1f}"`]{.key} ([`{python} f"{b_limit:.1f} m"`]{.key} span) before reaching the [`{python} f"{m_root_base:.1f} kN·m"`]{.key} [manoeuvre bending budget](../01-calibrated-discus-2c/2026-09-30-03-are-wing-structural-loads-reasonable-under-a-jar-22-5-3g-limit-manoeuv.qmd) (@fig-tandem-ar-trade). Favorable biplane interference cuts induced drag factor to [`{python} f"{k_limit:.5f}"`]{.key} ([`{python} f"{ir_limit:.3f}×"`]{.key} baseline). At this limit, glide ratio reaches [`{python} f"{ld_limit:.2f}"`]{.key}, beating the [baseline monoplane](../01-calibrated-discus-2c/2026-09-30-02-does-the-reconstructed-discus-2c-achieve-its-published-45-9-glide-rati.qmd) ([`{python} f"{ld_base_mono:.2f}"`]{.key}) by [`{python} f"+{delta_ld_limit:.2f}"`]{.key} points and the [18 m tandem](2026-09-30-02-does-18-m-full-span-recover-tandem-glide-while-retaining-bending-relie.qmd) by [`{python} f"+{delta_ld_base:.2f}"`]{.key}.

```{python}
#| label: fig-tandem-ar-trade
#| fig-cap: "Limit manoeuvre root bending moment and best glide ratio across tandem wing aspect ratios and spans up to the baseline cantilever bending limit."
fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 4.2))

# Subplot 1: Limit Root Bending Moment vs Span / AR
ax1.plot(res["spans"], res["m_root_arr"], "s-", color="forestgreen", lw=2.0, label="Tandem peak spar load")
ax1.axhline(m_root_base, color="steelblue", ls="--", lw=1.6, label=f"Baseline budget ({m_root_base:.1f} kN·m)")
ax1.axvline(b_limit, color="crimson", ls=":", lw=1.6, label=f"Limit span ({b_limit:.1f} m, AR {ar_limit:.1f})")
ax1.scatter([b_limit], [m_root_base], color="crimson", s=60, zorder=5)

ax1.set_xlabel("Span per wing $b$ [m]")
ax1.set_ylabel("Limit root bending moment [kN·m]")
ax1.set_title("Limit Manoeuvre Structural Loads (+5.3g)")
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax1.legend(loc="upper left", fontsize=8)

# Subplot 2: Best Glide Ratio vs Span / AR
ax2.plot(res["spans"], res["ld_max_arr"], "o-", color="darkorange", lw=2.0, label="Tandem best L/D")
ax2.axhline(ld_base_mono, color="steelblue", ls="--", lw=1.6, label=f"Baseline monoplane ({ld_base_mono:.1f})")
ax2.axvline(b_limit, color="crimson", ls=":", lw=1.6, label=f"Limit span ({b_limit:.1f} m, L/D={ld_limit:.1f})")
ax2.scatter([b_limit], [ld_limit], color="crimson", s=60, zorder=5)

ax2.set_xlabel("Span per wing $b$ [m]")
ax2.set_ylabel("Best glide ratio $L/D$ [-]")
ax2.set_title("Glide Performance vs Aspect Ratio")
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax2.legend(loc="lower right", fontsize=8)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
